question: Which of the following banks merged with Bank of Baroda in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dena Bank**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vijaya Bank and Dena Bank were merged with Bank of Baroda with effect from April 1, 2019.
 
• This is the first-ever three-way merger in Indian banking.
 
• After amalgamation, BOB became India's third-largest bank.
 
• Dena Bank said that its shareholders will receive 110 equity shares of Bank of Baroda of the face value of Rs. 2 for every 1,000 shares they held.
 
• Vijaya Bank shareholders will get 402 equity shares of Bank of Baroda for every 1,000 shares they held.
 
• Bank of Baroda (BOB) was established on July 20, 1908.
 
• Headquarters: Vadodara

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Canara Bank**:

 
 
• Established in 1906, Canara Bank is one of the largest public sector banks in India, offering a wide range of financial services including retail banking, corporate banking, and asset management. 4
 
• In 2020, it was merged with Syndicate Bank to strengthen its financial position and expand its reach.
 
 
 
• **Corporation Bank**:
 
 
• Founded in 1906, Corporation Bank was a well-established public sector bank in India, known for providing various banking and financial services.
 
• In 2020, it merged with Union Bank of India as part of the Indian government's banking consolidation initiative to enhance operational efficiency and financial stability.
 
 
 
• **United Bank of India**:
 
 
• Established in 1950, the United Bank of India played a key role in expanding banking services in the eastern and northeastern regions of India.
 
• In 2020, it merged with Punjab National Bank as part of a broader consolidation strategy in the Indian banking sector, aimed at creating larger, more robust institutions.
